resourceNotes.all: 2000 ms per move, at most 4 search threads, 64 MiB TT budget. Persistent readiness outside clock; observation, sampling, protocol, search, stop/reap inside clock.
resourceNotes.mist: Both arms are current production HCE search with the same bounded map arena; candidate changes internal stable sorting only. 8 worlds when dark, 1 when fully revealed. Same 40 ms host and up-to-35 ms core reserves. Candidate has a reusable scratch vector per Search; total RSS is not equal.
resourceNotes.rules: Common referee: mate/stalemate first, third same public board+turn loses for mover, 120 quiet draw, 400 cap unresolved. Both Mist engines retain legacy internal cycle=draw approximation. Pika own repetition search differs; common safeRoots filter forbids immediate repetition loss when alternatives exist.
